messages:
neha: Quick RFC follow-up 10: proposing 'gradual mosaic' fallback instead of single-target failover: when baseline drops, carve tiny shards of traffic to several fallback targets (old stable, quantized, cpu-degraded) to soften quality cliffs and reduce latency spikes. Thoughts?

ross: I like the concept. Key needs: a decision plane off the hot path, cost bounding, and clear signal contract (lat/err/quality). Router should only apply signed weight blobs.

clare: Ops checklist: immediate global abort, per-variant metrics, and audit logs for weight deltas. Also surface an "effective-weights" snapshot for oncall.

deploy-bot: :information_source: canary started id=cnr-17580 svc=text-gen baseline=v3 window=10m

neha: Implementation thought: a fallback-broker consumes aggregated telemetry, computes weight deltas, and publishes compact signed messages to router cache via pubsub. Routers validate generation + ttl and honor a synchronous emergency_abort flag. Keeps complexity out of critical path.

ross: Algorithm sketch: stepwise proportional ramps with minimum dwell time and reservoir counters to prevent thrash. Enforce two budgets: quality_budget (allowed delta) and cost_budget (cents/min).

clare: Sticky session problem: for latency-critical routes provide session-affinity tokens that pin sessions for N requests; also expose a per-route knob "affinity_window_ms". Document cache eviction when a variant is drained.

neha: Debugging: broker exposes /rollout/explain?req_id=... returning which rule fired, weight vector, and small-timeseries snippets. Also emit weight-change audit events to Events service.

ross: Pubsub message shape: compact JSON string with fields [route_id, weights[], gen, ttl, sig] so router can reject stale or tampered updates.

clare: Ops toggle example: curl -XPOST /api/flags/fallback/mosaic -d '{"enabled":true,"mode":"conservative"}'

neha: I'll write a short RFC addendum: DeploymentSpec additions, broker pubsub contract, telemetry contract (lat/err/quality/cost), algorithm steps, affinity knobs, and a runbook. Will circulate tomorrow. Ping me with edge cases. :pray:
